248.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a spoon imbued with telekinetic power that boosts Psychic-type moves.

249.name: Charcoal
249.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a combustible fuel that boosts the power of Fire-type moves.

250.name: Dragon Fang
250.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a hard and sharp fang that ups the power of Dragon-type moves.

251.name: Silk Scarf
251.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a sumptuous scarf that boosts the power of Normal-type moves.

252.name: Up-Grade
252.description: A transparent device filled with all sorts of data. It was produced by Silph Co.

253.name: Shell Bell
253.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The holder's HP is restored a little every time it inflicts damage.

254.name: Sea Incense
254.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is incense with a curious aroma that boosts the power of Water-type moves.

255.name: Lax Incense
255.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The tricky aroma of this incense may make attacks miss the holder.

256.name: Lucky Punch
256.description: An item to be held by Chansey. It is a pair of gloves that boosts Chansey's critical-hit ratio.

257.name: Metal Powder
257.description: An item to be held by Ditto. Extremely fine yet hard, this odd powder boosts the Defense stat.

258.name: Thick Club
258.description: An item to be held by Cubone or Marowak. It is a hard bone of some sort that boosts the Attack stat.

259.name: Stick
259.description: An item to be held by Farfetch'd. It is a very long and stiff stalk of leek that boosts the critical-hit ratio.

260.name: Red Scarf
260.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts the Cool aspect of the holder in a Contest.

261.name: Blue Scarf
261.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts the Beauty aspect of the holder in a Contest.

262.name: Pink Scarf
262.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts the Cute aspect of the holder in a Contest.

263.name: Green Scarf
263.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts the Smart aspect of the holder in a Contest.

264.name: Yellow Scarf
264.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts the Tough aspect of the holder in a Contest.

265.name: Wide Lens
265.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a magnifying lens that slightly boosts the accuracy of moves.

266.name: Muscle Band
266.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a headband that slightly boosts the power of physical moves.

267.name: Wise Glasses
267.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a thick pair of glasses that slightly boosts the power of special moves.

268.name: Expert Belt
268.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a well-worn belt that slightly boosts the power of supereffective moves.

269.name: Light Clay
269.description: A Pokémon held item that extends the duration of barrier moves like Light Screen and Reflect used by the holder.

270.name: Life Orb
270.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts the power of moves, but at the cost of some HP on each hit.

271.name: Power Herb
271.description: A single-use item to be held by a Pokémon. It allows the immediate use of a move that charges on the first turn.

272.name: Toxic Orb
272.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a bizarre orb that badly poisons the holder in battle.

273.name: Flame Orb
273.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a bizarre orb that inflicts a burn on the holder in battle.

274.name: Quick Powder
274.description: An item to be held by Ditto. Extremely fine yet hard, this odd powder boosts the Speed stat.

275.name: Focus Sash
275.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. If it has full HP, the holder will endure one potential KO attack, leaving 1 HP.

276.name: Zoom Lens
276.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. If the holder moves after its target, its accuracy will be boosted.

277.name: Metronome
277.description: A Pokémon held item that boosts a move used consecutively. Its effect is reset if another move is used.

278.name: Iron Ball
278.description: A Pokémon held item that cuts Speed. It makes Flying-type and levitating holders susceptible to Ground moves.

279.name: Lagging Tail
279.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is tremendously heavy and makes the holder move slower than usual.

280.name: Destiny Knot
280.description: A long, thin, bright-red string to be held by a Pokémon. If the holder becomes infatuated, the foe does too.

281.name: Black Sludge
281.description: A held item that gradually restores the HP of Poison-type Pokémon. It inflicts damage on all other types.

282.name: Icy Rock
282.description: A Pokémon held item that extends the duration of the move Hail used by the holder.

283.name: Smooth Rock
283.description: A Pokémon held item that extends the duration of the move Sandstorm used by the holder.

284.name: Heat Rock
284.description: A Pokémon held item that extends the duration of the move Sunny Day used by the holder.

285.name: Damp Rock
285.description: A Pokémon held item that extends the duration of the move Rain Dance used by the holder.

286.name: Grip Claw
286.description: A Pokémon held item that extends the duration of multiturn attacks like Bind and Wrap.

287.name: Choice Scarf
287.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This scarf boosts Speed, but allows the use of only one of its moves.

288.name: Sticky Barb
288.description: A held item that damages the holder on every turn. It may latch on to foes and allies that touch the holder.

289.name: Power Bracer
289.description: A Pokémon held item that promotes Attack gain on leveling, but reduces the Speed stat.

290.name: Power Belt
290.description: A Pokémon held item that promotes Defense gain on leveling, but reduces the Speed stat.

291.name: Power Lens
291.description: A Pokémon held item that promotes Sp. Atk gain on leveling, but reduces the Speed stat.

292.name: Power Band
292.description: A Pokémon held item that promotes Sp. Def gain on leveling, but reduces the Speed stat.

293.name: Power Anklet
293.description: A Pokémon held item that promotes Speed gain on leveling, but reduces the Speed stat.

294.name: Power Weight
294.description: A Pokémon held item that promotes HP gain on leveling, but reduces the Speed stat.

295.name: Shed Shell
295.description: A tough, discarded carapace to be held by a Pokémon. It enables the holder to switch with a waiting Pokémon in battle.

296.name: Big Root
296.description: A Pokémon held item that boosts the power of HP-stealing moves to let the holder recover more HP.

297.name: Choice Specs
297.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. These distinctive glasses boost Sp. Atk but allow the use of only one of its moves.

298.name: Flame Plate
298.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Fire-type moves.

299.name: Splash Plate
299.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Water-type moves.

300.name: Zap Plate
300.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Electric-type moves.

301.name: Meadow Plate
301.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Grass-type moves.

302.name: Icicle Plate
302.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Ice-type moves.

303.name: Fist Plate
303.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Fighting-type moves.

304.name: Toxic Plate
304.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Poison-type moves.

305.name: Earth Plate
305.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Ground-type moves.

306.name: Sky Plate
306.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Flying-type moves.

307.name: Mind Plate
307.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Psychic-type moves.

308.name: Insect Plate
308.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Bug-type moves.

309.name: Stone Plate
309.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Rock-type moves.

310.name: Spooky Plate
310.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Ghost-type moves.

311.name: Draco Plate
311.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Dragon-type moves.

312.name: Dread Plate
312.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Dark-type moves.

313.name: Iron Plate
313.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Steel-type moves.

314.name: Odd Incense
314.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is an exotic-smelling incense that boosts the power of Psychic-type moves.

315.name: Rock Incense
315.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is an exotic-smelling incense that boosts the power of Rock-type moves.

316.name: Full Incense
316.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is an exotic-smelling incense that makes the holder bloated and slow moving.

317.name: Wave Incense
317.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is incense with a curious aroma that boosts the power of Water-type moves.

318.name: Rose Incense
318.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is an exotic-smelling incense that boosts the power of Grass-type moves.

319.name: Luck Incense
319.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It doubles a battle's prize money if the holding Pokémon joins in.

320.name: Pure Incense
320.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It helps keep wild Pokémon away if the holder is the first one in the party.

321.name: Protector
321.description: A protective item of some sort. It is extremely stiff and heavy. It is loved by a certain Pokémon.

322.name: Electirizer
322.description: A box packed with a tremendous amount of electric energy. It is loved by a certain Pokémon.

323.name: Magmarizer
323.description: A box packed with a tremendous amount of magma energy. It is loved by a certain Pokémon.

324.name: Dubious Disc
324.description: A transparent device overflowing with dubious data. Its producer is unknown.

325.name: Reaper Cloth
325.description: A cloth imbued with horrifyingly strong spiritual energy. It is loved by a certain Pokémon.

326.name: Razor Claw
326.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a sharply hooked claw that ups the holder's critical-hit ratio.

327.name: Razor Fang
327.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It may make foes and allies flinch when the holder inflicts damage.

328.name: TM01
328.description: The user sharpens its claws to boost its Attack stat and accuracy.

329.name: TM02
329.description: The user slashes the target with huge, sharp claws.

330.name: TM03
330.description: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This attack does physical damage.

331.name: TM04
331.description: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to raise its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

332.name: TM05
332.description: The target is scared off and replaced by another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.

333.name: TM06
333.description: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

334.name: TM07
334.description: Summons a hailstorm that lasts for five turns. The hailstorm damages all types except Ice.

335.name: TM08
335.description: The user tenses its muscles to bulk up its body, boosting both its Attack and Defense stats.

336.name: TM09
336.description: The user drenches the target in a special poisonous liquid. Its power is doubled if the target is poisoned.

337.name: TM10
337.description: A unique attack that varies in type and intensity depending on the Pokémon using it.

338.name: TM11
338.description: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type moves.

339.name: TM12
339.description: The target is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for three turns.

340.name: TM13
340.description: The target is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. It may also freeze the target solid.

341.name: TM14
341.description: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike the opposing team. It may also freeze them solid.

342.name: TM15
342.description: The target is attacked with a powerful beam. The user must rest on the next turn to regain its energy.

343.name: TM16
343.description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to suppress damage from special attacks for five turns.

344.name: TM17
344.description: It enables the user to evade all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

345.name: TM18
345.description: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type moves.

346.name: TM19
346.description: The user makes the target float with its psychic power. The target is easier to hit for three turns.

347.name: TM20
347.description: The user creates a protective field that prevents status problems for five turns.

348.name: TM21
348.description: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the less the user likes its Trainer.

349.name: TM22
349.description: A two-turn attack. The user gathers light, then blasts a bundled beam on the second turn.

350.name: TM23
350.description: The user throws a stone or projectile to attack an opponent. A flying Pokémon will fall to the ground when it's hit.

351.name: TM24
351.description: A strong electric blast is loosed at the target. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

352.name: TM25
352.description: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the target to inflict damage. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

353.name: TM26
353.description: The user sets off an earthquake that strikes every Pokémon around it.

354.name: TM27
354.description: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the more the user likes its Trainer.

355.name: TM28
355.description: The user burrows, then attacks on the second turn. It can also be used to exit dungeons.

356.name: TM29
356.description: The target is hit by a strong telekinetic force. It may also reduce the target's Sp. Def stat.

357.name: TM30
357.description: The user hurls a shadowy blob at the target. It may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

358.name: TM31
358.description: The user attacks with tough fists, etc. It can also break any barrier such as Light Screen and Reflect.

359.name: TM32
359.description: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.

360.name: TM33
360.description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to suppress damage from physical attacks for five turns.

361.name: TM34
361.description: It swamps the area around the user with a giant sludge wave. It may also poison those hit.

362.name: TM35
362.description: The target is scorched with an intense blast of fire. It may also leave the target with a burn.

363.name: TM36
363.description: Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the target. It may also poison the target.

364.name: TM37
364.description: A five-turn sandstorm is summoned to hurt all combatants except the Rock, Ground, and Steel types.

365.name: TM38
365.description: The target is attacked with an intense blast of all-consuming fire. It may also leave the target with a burn.

366.name: TM39
366.description: Boulders are hurled at the target. It also lowers the target's Speed by preventing its movement.

367.name: TM40
367.description: The user confounds the target with speed, then slashes. The attack lands without fail.

368.name: TM41
368.description: The user torments and enrages the target, making it incapable of using the same move twice in a row.

369.name: TM42
369.description: An attack move that doubles its power if the user is poisoned, paralyzed, or has a burn.

370.name: TM43
370.description: The user cloaks itself with flame and attacks. Building up more power, it raises the user's Speed stat.

371.name: TM44
371.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. It fully restores the user's HP and heals any status problem.

372.name: TM45
372.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the target becomes infatuated and less likely to attack.

373.name: TM46
373.description: The user attacks and steals the target's held item simultaneously. It can't steal if the user holds an item.

374.name: TM47
374.description: The user attacks the target's legs swiftly, reducing the target's Speed stat.

375.name: TM48
375.description: The user attacks the target with a song. Others can join in the Round and make the attack do greater damage.

376.name: TM49
376.description: The user attacks the target with an echoing voice. If this move is used every turn, it does greater damage.

377.name: TM50
377.description: The user attacks the target at full power. The attack's recoil harshly reduces the user's Sp. Atk stat.

378.name: TM51
378.description: The user teleports using a strange power and switches its place with one of its allies.

379.name: TM52
379.description: The user heightens its mental focus and unleashes its power. It may also lower the target's Sp. Def.

380.name: TM53
380.description: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the target. It may also lower the target's Sp. Def.

381.name: TM54
381.description: A restrained attack that prevents the target from fainting. The target is left with at least 1 HP.

382.name: TM55
382.description: The user shoots boiling hot water at its target. It may also leave the target with a burn.

383.name: TM56
383.description: The user flings its held item at the target as an attack. Its power and effects depend on the item.

384.name: TM57
384.description: The user attacks with an electric charge. The user may use any remaining electricity to raise its Sp. Atk stat.

385.name: TM58
385.description: The user hurls the target into the air, then drops it on the second turn. The target cannot attack while in the air.

386.name: TM59
386.description: The user attacks the target with fire. If the target is holding a Berry, the Berry becomes burnt up and unusable.

387.name: TM60
387.description: The user suppresses the target and makes its move go last.

388.name: TM61
388.description: The user shoots a sinister, bluish-white flame at the target to inflict a burn.

389.name: TM62
389.description: The user nimbly strikes the target. If the user is not holding an item, this attack inflicts massive damage.

390.name: TM63
390.description: It prevents the target from using its held item. Its Trainer is also prevented from using items on it.

391.name: TM64
391.description: The user explodes to inflict damage on those around it. The user faints upon using this move.

392.name: TM65
392.description: The user slashes with a sharp claw made from shadows. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

393.name: TM66
393.description: The user stores power, then attacks. If the user can use this attack after the target, its power is doubled.

394.name: TM67
394.description: The user gets revenge for a fainted ally. If an ally fainted in the previous turn, this attack's damage increases.

395.name: TM68
395.description: The user charges at the target using every bit of its power. The user must rest on the next turn.

396.name: TM69
396.description: The user polishes its body to reduce drag. It sharply raises the Speed stat.

397.name: TM70
397.description: The user flashes a bright light that cuts the target's accuracy. It can also be used to illuminate caves.

398.name: TM71
398.description: The user stabs the foe with sharpened stones from below. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

399.name: TM72
399.description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

400.name: TM73
400.description: A weak electric charge is launched at the target. It causes paralysis if it hits.

401.name: TM74
401.description: The user tackles the target with a high-speed spin. The slower the user, the greater the damage.

402.name: TM75
402.description: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. It sharply raises the user's Attack stat.

403.name: TM76
403.description: Resisting, the user attacks the opposing Pokémon. The targets' Sp. Atk stat is reduced.

404.name: TM77
404.description: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the target.

405.name: TM78
405.description: The user stomps down on the ground and attacks everything in the area. The targets' Speed stat is reduced.

406.name: TM79
406.description: The user blows a cold breath on the target. This attack always results in a critical hit.

407.name: TM80
407.description: Large boulders are hurled at the opposing team to inflict damage. They may also make the targets flinch.

408.name: TM81
408.description: The user slashes at the target by crossing its scythes or claws as if they were a pair of scissors.

409.name: TM82
409.description: The user knocks away the target and drags out another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.

410.name: TM83
410.description: The user is roused, and its Attack and Sp. Atk stats increase.

411.name: TM84
411.description: The target is stabbed with a tentacle or arm steeped in poison. It may also poison the target.

412.name: TM85
412.description: The user eats the dreams of a sleeping target. It absorbs half the damage caused to heal the user's HP.

413.name: TM86
413.description: The user snares the target with grass and trips it. The heavier the target, the greater the damage.

414.name: TM87
414.description: The user enrages and confuses the target. However, it also sharply raises the target's Attack stat.

415.name: TM88
415.description: The user pecks the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user plucks it and gains its effect.

416.name: TM89
416.description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

417.name: TM90
417.description: The user makes a copy of itself using some of its HP. The copy serves as the user's decoy.

418.name: TM91
418.description: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it at once. It may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

419.name: TM92
419.description: The user creates a bizarre space in which slower Pokémon get to move first for five turns.

420.name: HM01
420.description: The target is cut with a scythe or claw. It can also be used to cut down thin trees.

421.name: HM02
421.description: The user soars, then strikes on the second turn. It can also be used to fly to any familiar town.

422.name: HM03
422.description: It swamps the area around the user with a giant wave. It can also be used for crossing water.

423.name: HM04
423.description: The target is slugged with a punch thrown at maximum power. This move can also be used to move boulders.

424.name: HM05
424.description: The user charges the target at an awesome speed. It can also be used to climb a waterfall.

425.name: HM06
425.description: Diving on the first turn, the user floats up and attacks on the second. It can be used for diving in the ocean.

428.name: Explorer Kit
428.description: A bag filled with convenient tools for exploring. It provides access to the Underground.

429.name: Loot Sack
429.description: A sturdy, spacious bag that is used to carry loot obtained in the coal mine.

430.name: Rule Book
430.description: It lists the rules for holding battles. For linked battles, you may choose which set of rules you wish to use.

431.name: Poké Radar
431.description: A tool that can search out Pokémon that are hiding in grass. Its battery is recharged as you walk.

432.name: Point Card
432.description: A card that lists the Battle Points you have earned.

433.name: Journal
433.description: A notebook that keeps a day-to-day record of your adventure so far.

434.name: Seal Case
434.description: A case for storing Seals that can be applied to the Capsule cases of Poké Balls.

435.name: Fashion Case
435.description: A lovely case to store colorful Props for your Pokémon to wear in a musical.

436.name: Seal Bag
436.description: A tiny bag that can hold 10 Seals for decorating Poké Balls.

437.name: Pal Pad
437.description: A convenient notepad that is used for registering your friends, Friend Codes, and keeping a record of game play.

438.name: Works Key
438.description: A large key for operating the doors of the Valley Windworks in the canyon. It was held by a Team Galactic Grunt.

439.name: Old Charm
439.description: An ancient good-luck charm made of Pokémon bones to be taken to the elder of Celestic Town.

440.name: Galactic Key
440.description: A card key for disengaging security systems in the Galactic HQ. Losing it can result in punishment, apparently.

441.name: Red Chain
441.description: A mythical chain that is said to link the legendary Pokémon that created the Sinnoh region.

442.name: Town Map
442.description: A very convenient map that can be viewed anytime. It even shows your present location.

443.name: Vs. Seeker
443.description: A device that indicates Trainers who want to battle. Its battery charges while you walk.

444.name: Coin Case
444.description: A case for holding coins obtained at the Game Corner. It holds up to 50,000 coins.

445.name: Old Rod
445.description: An old and beat-up fishing rod. Use it by any body of water to fish for wild aquatic Pokémon.

446.name: Good Rod
446.description: A new, good-quality fishing rod. Use it by any body of water to fish for wild aquatic Pokémon.

447.name: Super Rod
447.description: An awesome, high-tech fishing rod. Use it by any body of water to fish for wild aquatic Pokémon.

448.name: Sprayduck
448.description: A watering can shaped like a Psyduck. It helps promote healthy growth of Berries planted in soft soil.

449.name: Poffin Case
449.description: A case for storing Poffin cooked from Berries.

450.name: Bicycle
450.description: A folding Bicycle that enables much faster movement than the Running Shoes.

451.name: Suite Key
451.description: A key to one of the suites at the luxury hotel by a lake. For some odd reason, it often disappears.

452.name: Oak's Letter
452.description: A letter from Prof. Oak. Written in it is a request for you to go to Rt. 224.

453.name: Lunar Wing
453.description: A feather that glows like the moon. It is said to possess the power to dispel nightmares.

454.name: Member Card
454.description: A card needed for entering the inn in Canalave City. Oddly, the last date marked on it was 50 years ago.

455.name: Azure Flute
455.description: A flute that puts out echoing sounds that do not seem to be of this world. It is unknown who made it.

456.name: S.S. Ticket
456.description: The ticket required for sailing on the ferry S.S. Aqua. It has a drawing of a ship on it.

457.name: Contest Pass
457.description: The pass required for entering Pokémon Contests. It has a drawing of an award ribbon on it.

458.name: Magma Stone
458.description: A stone formed when boulders melted in intensely hot magma, then hardened. Magma remains sealed inside.

459.name: Parcel
459.description: A parcel entrusted in your care. You are supposed to deliver it to your childhood friend who left Twinleaf Town.

460.name: Coupon 1
460.description: A coupon to be exchanged for a Pokémon Watch (Pokétch for short). Three coupons are needed.

461.name: Coupon 2
461.description: A coupon to be exchanged for a Pokémon Watch (Pokétch for short). Three coupons are needed.

462.name: Coupon 3
462.description: A coupon to be exchanged for a Pokémon Watch (Pokétch for short). Three coupons are needed.

463.name: Storage Key
463.description: The key to Team Galactic's sinister warehouse located at the edge of Veilstone City.

464.name: SecretPotion
464.description: A fantastic medicine dispensed by the pharmacy in Cianwood City. It fully heals a Pokémon of any ailment.

465.name: Vs. Recorder
465.description: An amazing device that can record a battle either between friends or at a special battle facility.

466.name: Gracidea
466.description: A flower sometimes bundled in bouquets to convey gratitude on special occasions like birthdays.

467.name: Secret Key
467.description: A high-tech key that has to be used at a specific location. It emits a special electric signal to open a door.

468.name: Apricorn Box
468.description: A handy box where you can store up to 99 Apricorns of each kind.

469.name: Unown Report
469.description: A report of all the discovered kinds of Unown.

470.name: Berry Pots
470.description: Handy containers for cultivating Berries wherever you go.

471.name: Dowsing MCHN
